title: Berkshire CEO Greg Abel Is Sitting on Nearly $400 Billion in Cash. Here's How His Deal-Making Approach Differs From Warren Buffett's.
title_zh: 伯克希尔首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔 (Greg Abel) 坐拥近 4000 亿美元现金。以下是他的交易方法与沃伦·巴菲特的不同之处。
summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new CEO has the firepower to make big deals, and his first deal reveals how he's likely to approach acquisitions.
summary_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司的新任首席执行官拥有进行大笔交易的火力，他的第一笔交易揭示了他可能如何进行收购。

title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Joins Early Section 48E Tax Equity Deal
title_zh: Apollo Global Management (APO) 加入早期第 48E 节税收股权交易
summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO) is involved in one of the industry's first Section 48E tax equity transactions to fund distributed clean energy projects in Illinois, alongside Summit Ridge Energy and Foss & Company.
summary_zh: Apollo Global Management（纽约证券交易所股票代码：APO）与 Summit Ridge Energy 和 Foss & Company 一起参与了业界首批第 48E 条税收股权交易之一，为伊利诺伊州的分布式清洁能源项目提供资金。

title: How NVIDIA’s AI Compute Financing Push and Blupine Deal Interest Could Impact Blackstone (BX) Investors
title_zh: NVIDIA 的 AI 计算融资推动和 Blupine 交易兴趣如何影响 Blackstone (BX) 投资者
summary: In August 2026, NVIDIA announced it had entered into partnerships with Blackstone, Apollo, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to create new compute financing platforms that could mobilize over US$500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure across its eco...
summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，NVIDIA 宣布已与 Blackstone、Apollo、BlackRock、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs 和 KKR 建立合作伙伴关系，创建新的计算融资平台，可以为整个生态系统的 AI 基础设施动员超过 5000 亿美元的第三方资本。

title: Broadcom seeks up to $80 billion in debt for AI chip deal
title_zh: 博通为人工智能芯片交易寻求高达 800 亿美元的债务
summary: The chip designer is in talks with lenders on a deal that would benefit Anthropic and other AI companies, with a total potential raise of up to $100 billion
summary_zh: 这家芯片设计公司正在与贷方就一项交易进行谈判，该交易将使 Anthropic 和其他人工智能公司受益，潜在融资总额高达 1000 亿美元

title: Broadcom Eyes Up to $100 Billion AI Financing Deal
title_zh: 博通瞄准高达 1000 亿美元的人工智能融资交易
summary: The debt package could help fund Anthropic and other AI customers.
summary_zh: 该债务计划可以帮助为 Anthropic 和其他人工智能客户提供资金。
